items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: We featured Brown Skin, Who You Follow, which Will Rossiter published.

ctx.x: This is a letter. It says, It says, From A.J. P. Ron, 1734 Annette Street, New Orleans, Louisiana. The dateline is August 13, 1922. Mr. D. James LaRocca, original Dixon and Jazz Band. 421 Sheets Head Bay Road, Brooklyn, New York. My dear Mr. LaRocca, yours of the fifth INST comp was received and very sorry indeed for the delay and great suspense that you no doubt suffered. But only to the fact that I was out of the city, I was unable to answer at once. But I assure you that I have taken great interest in saying,…

Well this will show that I did try to help the colored man out, and I had no malice or thought of doing anybody anything that was out of the way of being honest with anyone. We featured these numbers that rise to others. We featured Brown Skin, Who You Follow, which Will Rossiter published. That's one of his numbers. We featured Mama's Baby Boy. Now, it's been said that we played many Negro melodies. That is true. Because we played many other tunes. Let me get back. And we also featured Sister Kate. It was all of…
Who did the singing of the band?
